dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: I read it in a book of legends, but the details of the content escape me nowadays... Still, I recall that its own owner was a figure of much wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: Wisdom comes in many forms. Printed on paper, woven upon cloth, and even spread by word of mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Amazolli
dialogues.text: And that's why I named my store after them.
